name: StayOS PMS
description: PMS (frontend + Nest API + worker BullMQ + Postgres + Redis). Build a partir do GitHub ojfernandess/pms-project (branch PMS-Backend).

importPayload.compose:
# Dokploy: use este ficheiro como Compose path (raiz do repo após git clone).
# Caminhos build relativos à raiz — evita ".../code/backend not found".
# Postgres + Redis + backend + worker + frontend (ver deploy/dokploy/README.md).
version: "3.8"

services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-postgres}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?POSTGRES_PASSWORD obrigatória}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-pms}
    volumes:
      - pms_postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test:
        [
          "CMD-SHELL",
          "pg_isready -U ${POSTGRES_USER:-postgres} -d ${POSTGRES_DB:-pms}",
        ]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 20

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - pms_redis:/data
    expose:
      - "6379"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 20

  backend:
    build:
      context: ./backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    restart: unless-stopped
    expose:
      - "3000"
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: production
      PORT: "3000"
      DATABASE_URL: ${DATABASE_URL:?DATABASE_URL obrigatória}
      REDIS_URL: ${REDIS_URL:-redis://redis:6379}
      PRISMA_MIGRATE_ON_START: ${PRISMA_MIGRATE_ON_START:-false}
      JWT_SECRET: ${JWT_SECRET:?JWT_SECRET obrigatório (mín. 32 caracteres)}
      JWT_ACCESS_TTL: ${JWT_ACCESS_TTL:-15m}
      JWT_REFRESH_TTL_DAYS: ${JWT_REFRESH_TTL_DAYS:-7}
      INTERNAL_API_TOKEN: ${INTERNAL_API_TOKEN:-}
      SOCKET_AUTH_TOKEN: ${SOCKET_AUTH_TOKEN:-}
      PUBLIC_APP_URL: ${PUBLIC_APP_URL:-}
      SITE_URL: ${SITE_URL:-}
      CORS_ORIGINS: ${CORS_ORIGINS:-}
      PASSWORD_RESET_DEBUG: ${PASSWORD_RESET_DEBUG:-false}
      SUPABASE_URL: ${SUPABASE_URL:-}
      SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: ${SUPABASE_ANON_KEY:-}
    volumes:
      - pms_storage:/app/storage
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test:
        [
          "CMD",
          "node",
          "-e",
          "fetch('http://127.0.0.1:3000/health').then(r=>process.exit(r.ok?0:1)).catch(()=>process.exit(1))",
        ]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 120s

  worker:
    build:
      context: ./backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: ["./scripts/docker-entrypoint-worker.sh"]
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: production
      PMS_RUN_MODE: worker
      DATABASE_URL: ${WORKER_DATABASE_URL:-${DATABASE_URL}}
      REDIS_URL: ${REDIS_URL:-redis://redis:6379}
      JWT_SECRET: ${JWT_SECRET}
      JWT_ACCESS_TTL: ${JWT_ACCESS_TTL:-15m}
      JWT_REFRESH_TTL_DAYS: ${JWT_REFRESH_TTL_DAYS:-7}
      INTERNAL_API_TOKEN: ${INTERNAL_API_TOKEN:-}
      SOCKET_AUTH_TOKEN: ${SOCKET_AUTH_TOKEN:-}
      PUBLIC_APP_URL: ${PUBLIC_APP_URL:-}
      SITE_URL: ${SITE_URL:-}
    volumes:
      - pms_storage:/app/storage
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
      backend:
        condition: service_healthy

  frontend:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      args:
        VITE_PMS_API_URL: ${VITE_PMS_API_URL:-https://localhost}
        VITE_SUPABASE_URL: ${VITE_SUPABASE_URL:-}
        VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY: ${VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY:-}
        VITE_APP_URL: ${VITE_APP_URL:-https://localhost}
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      BACKEND_UPSTREAM: ${BACKEND_UPSTREAM:-http://backend:3000}
    expose:
      - "80"
    depends_on:
      backend:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "-qO-", "http://127.0.0.1/"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

volumes:
  pms_postgres:
  pms_redis:
  pms_storage:
importPayload.config:
# Dokploy template — StayOS PMS (import via pms-install.json)
[variables]
main_domain = "${domain}"
postgres_password = "${password}"
jwt_secret = "${password:48}"
internal_api_token = "${password:32}"
socket_auth_token = "${password:32}"

[config]
mounts = []

env = [
  "POSTGRES_USER=postgres",
  "POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${postgres_password}",
  "POSTGRES_DB=pms",
  "DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:${postgres_password}@postgres:5432/pms?schema=public&connection_limit=10&pool_timeout=30",
  "WORKER_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:${postgres_password}@postgres:5432/pms?schema=public&connection_limit=3&pool_timeout=30",
  "REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379",
  "JWT_SECRET=${jwt_secret}",
  "INTERNAL_API_TOKEN=${internal_api_token}",
  "SOCKET_AUTH_TOKEN=${socket_auth_token}",
  "JWT_ACCESS_TTL=15m",
  "JWT_REFRESH_TTL_DAYS=7",
  "PUBLIC_APP_URL=https://${main_domain}",
  "SITE_URL=https://${main_domain}",
  "VITE_PMS_API_URL=https://${main_domain}",
  "VITE_APP_URL=https://${main_domain}",
  "BACKEND_UPSTREAM=http://backend:3000",
  "PRISMA_MIGRATE_ON_START=false",
  "PASSWORD_RESET_DEBUG=false",
  "VITE_SUPABASE_URL=",
  "VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=",
  "SUPABASE_URL=",
  "SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=",
]

[[config.domains]]
serviceName = "frontend"
port = 80
host = "${main_domain}"
path = "/"

notes: No Dokploy: Import → cole SÓ deploy/dokploy/pms-install.base64 (não o .json).
Ligue o repositório Git na raiz do monorepo (mesma branch).
Primeiro Postgres vazio: defina PRISMA_MIGRATE_ON_START=true no Environment, deploy, depois volte a false.
DATABASE_URL no painel: só a URL, sem prefixo DATABASE_URL=.
